```{r}
library(dplyr)

d <- read.csv('../data/raw/response_concreteness_ratings_knowledge_corr.csv')
d <- d %>%
   mutate_at(2:5, funs(c(scale(.)))) %>%
  select(-response_rel_freq)
```


```{r}
model <- lm(know ~ ., data=d)
summary(model)
```
